topic: 被动语态全景突破（从基础动作到高阶综合考点）
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：被动语态就像是给句子换了个“主角”！主动语态强调“动作的发出者”（如：小明吃了苹果），而被动语态强调“动作的承受者”（如：苹果被小明吃了）。当不知道施动者是谁，或者需要突出承受对象时，被动语态就登场啦！
2. 【口诀/公式】：核心公式：主语 + be + 过去分词 (V-ed/V3) (+ by 施动者)。记忆口诀：“被动语态 be 开头，过去分词紧跟后；时态变化看 be 动，主谓一致不能忘！”
3. 【避坑指南】：① 误用原形或过去式：be 动词后面必须用过去分词（如 is eaten，不能用 is eat 或 is ate）；② 遗漏短语动词的介词：短语动词变被动时介词不能丢（如 look after 变被动为 be looked after）；③ 不及物动词误用被动：happen, disappear 等不及物动词没有被动语态，绝不能写 was happened！
4. 【经典例句】：① Primary: The bedroom is cleaned by Tom every day.（卧室每天都被汤姆打扫。） ② Secondary: A new school will be built in our town next year.（明年我们镇上将建一所新学校。） ③ Advanced: He was seen to enter the building late last night.（有人看到他昨晚很晚进了这栋楼。）

questions.question: English _______ by millions of people in many countries every day.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般现在时的被动语态。主语 English 是动作 speak 的承受者，且根据时间状语 every day 可知用一般现在时，结构为 is + 过去分词 spoken。

questions.question: The classroom _______ by the students yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般过去时的被动语态。主语 The classroom 单数，时间标志词 yesterday afternoon 表明是过去，因此用 was + cleaned。

questions.question: Many beautiful flowers _______ in our school garden every spring.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般现在时复数主语的被动语态。主语 flowers 为复数，动词应用 are planted。

questions.question: These sweet photos _______ during our trip to Beijing last summer.
questions.explanation: 照片是被拍摄的（be taken），且发生时间为 last summer（过去），主语 photos 为复数，故选 were taken。

questions.question: This simple math problem _______ easily by a primary school student.
questions.explanation: 本题考查含情态动词 can 的被动语态。结构为：情态动词 + be + 过去分词 (can be solved)。

questions.question: Mobile phones _______ in the exam rooms.
questions.explanation: 手机“不被允许”（be not allowed）带入考场。主语 Mobile phones 为复数，故选 are not allowed。

questions.question: _______ this delicious birthday cake made by your mum yesterday?
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般过去时被动语态的一般疑问句。句尾有 yesterday，且动词是 made，疑问句将 be 动词 Was 提到句首。

questions.question: Lunch _______ at 12:00 every day in our school cafeteria.
questions.explanation: 午饭是“被供应/提供”的，结合 every day（一般现在时）与不可数名词 Lunch（单数），应填 is served。

questions.question: The classic story Harry Potter _______ by J.K. Rowling.
questions.explanation: 《哈利·波特》是被罗琳写作出来的，动作发生在过去，选 was written。

questions.question: All the trash _______ into the correct bins before we leave.
questions.explanation: 考查含情态动词 must 的被动语态。put 的过去分词仍为 put（put-put-put），因此为 must be put。

questions.question: The missing keys _______ by Lucy under the sofa this morning.
questions.explanation: 主语 keys 为复数，时间为 this morning（过去），钥匙被找到，故选 were found。

questions.question: Paper _______ from wood, so we should save paper.
questions.explanation: 考查客观事实的一般现在时被动语态。be made from 表示“由……制成”（看不出原料），纸张不可数，用 is made。

questions.question: We _______ to the teacher's office after the class yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意为“昨天课后我们被叫到了老师办公室”。人是被叫的，时间是过去，用 were called。

questions.question: A terrible traffic accident _______ near the park yesterday.
questions.explanation: 【避坑易错题】happen 是不及物动词，没有被动语态！绝对不能说 was happened。直接用过去式 happened。

questions.question: Fresh water _______ by everyone in our daily life.
questions.explanation: 句意：每个人在日常生活中都应该节约淡水。水是被节约的，含有情态动词 should，故用 should be saved。

questions.question: A brand new modern library _______ in our school since last month.
questions.explanation: 考查现在完成时的被动语态。时间状语 since last month 配合现在完成时，结构为 has/have been + 过去分词。

questions.question: Listen! A beautiful melody _______ on the piano by someone in the music room.
questions.explanation: 考查现在进行时的被动语态。由提示词 Listen! 可知动作正在进行，结构为 is/are being + 过去分词 (is being played)。

questions.question: The sick puppy was well _______ by the volunteers at the animal shelter.
questions.explanation: 考查短语动词的被动形式。look after 是固定短语，变被动语态时介词 after 绝不能遗漏，即 was looked after。

questions.question: When I walked past the hall, the stage _______ for the evening concert.
questions.explanation: 考查过去进行时的被动语态。表示过去某一具体时刻（When I walked past...）正在被进行的动作，结构为 was/were being + V3。

questions.question: By the time the firefighters arrived, the old wooden building _______ down completely.
questions.explanation: 考查过去完成时的被动语态。By the time + 过去时从句，主句用过去完成时（过去的过去），表达“已经被烧毁”，故选 had been burnt。

questions.question: She _______ a valuable golden watch on her 18th birthday by her grandparents.
questions.explanation: 考查双宾语动词的被动语态。give sb sth 变为被动后，人做主语用 sb be given sth，故选 was given。

questions.question: The final results of the national competition _______ on the official website next Monday.
questions.explanation: 考查一般将来时的被动语态。时间为 next Monday，主语 results 被公布，用 will be published。

questions.question: The talented young pianist expects _______ to perform at the royal concert hall.
questions.explanation: 考查不定式的被动语态。expect to do sth（期待做某事），由于“她”是被邀请，故用不定式的被动结构 expect to be invited。

questions.question: It _______ that regular exercise combined with good sleep improves academic performance.
questions.explanation: 考查固定被动句型 It is believed that...（人们相信……/据信……），It 为形式主语，that 从句为真正主语。

questions.question: The mischievous boy was made _______ the whole classroom after school by his teacher.
questions.explanation: 【高频考点】使役动词 make 在主动语态中用不带 to 的不定式（make sb do sth），但变为被动语态时必须补上 to（be made to do sth）。

questions.question: The urgent letter was supposed to arrive yesterday; it _______ two days ago.
questions.explanation: 考查情态动词对过去的虚拟/被动推测。should have been done 表示“本应该在过去被做却未做”，符合本句对过去事实的遗憾与指责。

questions.question: Nobody enjoys _______ at in public when they make a silly mistake.
questions.explanation: 考查动名词的被动语态及短语介词保留。enjoy 后接 V-ing 形式，laugh at 为固定短语变被动介词 at 不能漏掉，故选 being laughed at。

questions.question: These safety regulations must be strictly _______ by all employees.
questions.explanation: 考查短语动词 comply with（遵守）的被动语态。情态动词 must + be + 过去分词短语，介词 with 必须保留。

questions.question: The roasted chicken smells so delicious that my mouth _______ water.
questions.explanation: 【陷阱辨析】make one's mouth water（令人流口水）是固定主动习惯表达。此外表示感官/属性的动词如 smell, taste 常用主动形式表示被动或状态。

questions.question: The ancient glass artifact is extremely delicate; it needs to _______ with extreme care.
questions.explanation: 考查 need to be done 结构。主语 it（文物）与 handle（拿取/处理）是被动关系，need to 后接不定式被动结构 to be handled。
